SAP Concur

Manage expense reports, travel requests, cash advances, and more in SAP Concur

Nutzungsanweisungen

Connect SAP Concur via OAuth 2.0. Manage expense reports and line items, allocations, attendees, comments, exceptions, quick expenses, receipts, travel requests and expected expenses, cash advances, itineraries, user identities, custom lists, budgets, exchange rates, and purchase requests across every Concur datacenter.

Tools

sap_concur_approve_expense_report

Approve an expense report as a manager (PATCH /expensereports/v4/reports/{reportId}/approve). Required body field: comment.

Eingabe

ParameterTypErforderlichBeschreibung
datacenterstringNeinConcur datacenter base URL (defaults to us.api.concursolutions.com)
grantTypestringNeinOAuth grant type: client_credentials (default) or password
clientIdstringJaConcur OAuth client ID
clientSecretstringJaConcur OAuth client secret
usernamestringNeinUsername (only for password grant)
passwordstringNeinPassword (only for password grant)
companyUuidstringNeinCompany UUID for multi-company access tokens
reportIdstringJaExpense report ID to approve
bodyjsonJaRequest body â€” comment is required by Concur (e.g., { "comment": "Approved" }). If the report contains rejected expenses, expenseRejectedComment is also required. Optional fields: expectedStepCode, expectedStepSequence, statusId (defaults to "A_APPR").

Ausgabe

ParameterTypBeschreibung
statusnumberHTTP status code returned by Concur
datajsonEmpty (204 No Content)
